# dash0_team (Data Source)

Looks up a Dash0 team by its display name or id. Use it to reference a team that Terraform does not manage, such as a team synced from your identity provider, for example as the `teamId` of a grant in `spec.permissions` of a `dash0_dataset`.

Set exactly one of `name` or `id`. Dash0 allows two teams to have the same display name. When more than one team has the name, the lookup fails and lists their ids, so you can look the team up by `id` instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a team that Terraform does not manage, for example a team synced
# from your identity provider, by its display name. The match is exact and
# case-sensitive. The lookup fails when no team has the name, or when more
# than one team has it. In that case, look the team up by id instead.
data "dash0_team" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"
}

# Grant the team access to a dataset.
resource "dash0_dataset" "payments" {
  dataset_yaml = <<-YAML
apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1
kind: Dash0Dataset
metadata:
  name: Payments
spec:
  permissions:
    - teamId: ${data.dash0_team.payments.id}
      actions: [dataset:read]
YAML
}

# Look up a team by id instead of by name.
data "dash0_team" "platform" {
  id = "team_01h455vb4pex5vsknk084sn02q"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the team, for example `team_01h455vb4pex5vsknk084sn02q`. Set it to look up the team by id instead of by name.
- `name` (String) The display name of the team, as shown in Dash0. The match is exact and case-sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `member_count` (Number) The number of members in the team.
- `origin` (String) The external identifier of the team, set by the tool that created it. Null for teams created in the Dash0 UI.
